engine.sourceCommitEvidence: Not built for this run: the engine is the one installed by the board's current CACP Yocto image, run as found. Source commit from the image's BUILD-TIME records (pqctoday-cacp/out/imx95/20260920213212/): SBOM pqc-cacp-image-imx95-15x15-lpddr4x-frdm.rootfs-20260920213212.spdx.json downloadLocation git+https://github.com/pqctoday-org/pqctoday-hsm.git@44e7207229f875bb3bb6e57a70e812886eac0435; image package manifest `softhsmrustv3 armv8-2a 0.17.0+git0+44e7207229-r0`; recipe SRCREV = PQCTODAY_HSM_SRCREV (meta-pqc-hsm/conf/pqctoday-hsm-src.inc = 44e7207229f875bb3bb6e57a70e812886eac0435 at cacp c047274a). The commit is an ancestor of pqctoday-hsm origin/main. On-board SHA-256 of /usr/lib/softhsm/libsofthsmrustv3.so (7d57ad56e8d06d9c4332e56b1197de7c2e1f45402395dbac3e3676a967d6ecb0) equals the same file extracted read-only (debugfs) from that bundle's .wic rootfs. The board runs that image: its root is SD card serial 0x00000232, which the cacp release note docs/releases/2026-09-20-mx95-network-separation.md records as carrying build 20260920213212, and its rootfs partition (mmcblk1p2, 2057482 KiB) equals the .wic's partition 2 size exactly. CAVEAT: the image's cacp revision is stamped c047274a…-dirty (the build started from a working tree with uncommitted changes), so recipe-level build settings are those of commit c047274a only as far as the uncommitted changes did not touch the engine recipes; the hsm source commit itself is fixed by the build-time SBOM and package version.

Image: CACP pqc-cacp-image for imx95-15x15-lpddr4x-frdm, build id 20260920213212 (bundle pqctoday-cacp/out/imx95/20260920213212/build-metadata.json), compressed WIC SHA-256 e7fa1bcbfe014b4e685faf9551b032216c9b34af7b292e880d971800cd383ecf, cacp revision c047274a7c165b771357994c1e627a2cd440439c-dirty. The board itself carries no build-identity file (/etc/version and /etc/timestamp are the reproducible-build constant 20180309123456; /etc/pqc/build-epoch is SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH 1302044400), so the build id comes from the cacp records tied above.

Reached over the lab LAN: 192.168.4.30 on the Mac's en0 (192.168.4.0/22), MAC 00:04:9f:0b:4f:48 (NXP OUI), SSH admin with the operator key. Read-only: runner and bundle staged in a private mktemp dir under /tmp (tmpfs) and removed afterwards; engine-side persistence/logging env vars (SOFTHSMRUST_STATE_FILE, PQC_BEHAVIOUR_RING, PQC_BEHAVIOUR_SRC, PQC_AUTH_LOG, SOFTHSM3_OP_LOG) explicitly unset, so the run used a private in-memory/tmp token and did not touch the appliance's token store or behaviour ring. Board clock NTP-synchronised at run time.

aws-lc-rs 1.18.0 (aws-lc-sys 0.44.0) is statically linked for the RSA / NIST-curve ECDH fast path only (rust/src/crypto/awslc.rs @ 44e72072; crypto::awslc_pq does not exist at this commit), so ML-KEM decapsulation and ML-DSA verification run on the pure-Rust crates.
